_doc: T-209 (UPDATE 12 s3): the archive-reel versions of the three history cutscenes. Each scene's reel shots cover spans of the in-engine timeline (data/gravelight/cutscenes_lazarus.json; `replaces` = the in-engine shot indices of that file). A reel shot whose clip is built (built_root/<scene>/shot_NN.ogv, made by tools/cinema/archive_reel.py build from raw_root/<scene>/shot_NN.mp4) plays as a cinema_video span; otherwise the in-engine shots under it play through the same film treatment as a shader (CinemaFilm). The timeline, the lines, the cards' times, the beds, skip and the online sync are the in-engine scene's. `prompt` is the content after the style block; docs/cutscenes/SHOT_PROMPTS.md is written from this file (python -I tools/cinema/archive_reel.py prompts). `cards` give each black card shot's native lines (Russian or German) over the English text of the in-engine card. `narration` is the slot for lines a later ElevenLabs bake adds ([t, line id]); a line without a take is silence in the reel and a row in the dry-run report.
style_block: Black-and-white 1930s/1940s archival film footage, heavy film grain, flicker, scratches and dust, hand-cranked camera judder, documentary realism
closing: No text, lettering, numbers, insignia, emblems or logos anywhere in frame. Nobody is struck or hurt on screen. Every person is fictional.

native: село, долгий день на подводе от районного города
Четвероднева нет ни на одной карте.

shots.prompt: A rutted village road in the spring thaw, 1930, rural Russia: brown water standing in the ruts, dirty snow in the ditches and under the wattle fences, bare birches on both sides, low log houses with carved window frames. At the far end of the road a small wooden parish church with a dull onion dome and, beside it, a separate tall wooden bell tower with a tent-shaped shingled roof; a bell swings in its open belfry. Grey overcast light, smoke from one chimney, rooks over the birches. The camera dollies slowly forward at knee height along the ruts.
shots.must_show: The road, the wooden church and the separate tent-roofed bell tower at its end, the bell swinging. No people yet.

shots.prompt: About forty villagers kneel in a loose band across a muddy village road in the thaw, seen from the side and slightly behind on a long lens: old men with their caps held in their hands, women in dark shawls, children held by the shoulders. Nobody moves or speaks. Far behind them, down the road between the birches, a small 1920s canvas-backed lorry with people standing in the back comes slowly toward them, sliding in the ruts. Locked-off camera, grey light.
shots.must_show: The kneeling line across the road, quiet and dignified; the lorry small and far off, approaching.

shots.prompt: A 1920s canvas-backed lorry stops in the mud of a village road. Young men and two young women climb down from the back in town overcoats, quilted jackets and peaked caps, plain cloth armbands on their sleeves, carrying crowbars, coiled rope and a tin speaking trumpet; a small wooden crate is handed down carefully. Last, a young man in a plain khaki tunic and a peaked cap steps out of the cab, looks up the road and quickly looks away. The camera tracks alongside the lorry at shoulder height.
shots.must_show: The brigade arriving with their tools, tired young people doing a job; the young officer (Volkov) last out of the cab, uneasy.

shots.prompt: The weathered plank door of a small wooden church at the top of three steps. On the step stands an elderly Orthodox village priest, lean, with a long grey beard, in a worn black cassock and a soft black cap, a ring of four iron keys in one hand. He does not move. In the out-of-focus foreground the backs of kneeling villagers; out of focus behind them, figures in town coats walk among them. Nobody touches anyone in frame. Locked-off camera from the road.
shots.must_show: Father Serafim at the door, calm and immovable, shot with respect; the road in front of him out of focus.

shots.prompt: Close on the elderly priest's face, grey beard, kind tired eyes; he lifts his free hand, palm down, gently, toward people beyond the camera, as if telling them to stand up and go home. The camera eases back to show a young man in a khaki tunic and peaked cap on the step below him holding a sheet of paper, speaking up to him, formal and stiff. Soft grey daylight, shallow focus.
shots.must_show: Serafim's gesture (get up, go home) and then the two men: the priest above, the young officer below with his warrant.

shots.prompt: Close-up of an old man's weathered hand in the black sleeve of a cassock, holding a ring of four large iron keys against the folds of the cloth. The fingers close around the keys, not into a fist, simply not letting go. Out of focus beyond, the khaki shoulder of a young man. Still camera.
shots.must_show: The keys held, not given; quiet resistance, no struggle.

shots.prompt: Low angle at the foot of a wooden church porch: a young officer in a khaki tunic turns away from the closed double door and speaks quietly to an older man in a leather cap and a leather coat, keeping his voice down, explaining, in control. The two of them look small against the tall iron-strapped door. The older man nods. The camera holds still at step height.
shots.must_show: Volkov managing it, telling the brigade head 'no roughness'; the closed door behind them. The shot ends before anyone lays a hand on the priest.

shots.prompt: The camera cranes slowly up a tall wooden bell tower with a shingled tent roof to its open belfry: a rope runs up to a bronze bell in a wooden yoke, and two men on the belfry rail work at the yoke with a crowbar. Far below at the foot of the tower, small and out of focus, an elderly priest kneels in the mud with his head bowed in prayer. Daylight, thin cloud.
shots.must_show: The bell being taken down; the priest far below, praying.

shots.prompt: From the ground looking up at an open wooden belfry: a bronze church bell swings out over the rail on a rope, hands pay out the rope, the rope runs and the bell falls out of frame. Cut to ground level: the bell lies on its side in the mud, a dark crack running up its waist, mud on the bronze; a villager's hand reaches into frame, touches the crack, and is drawn back.
shots.must_show: The bell's fall and the cracked bell in the mud; the grief in the one hand that touches it.

shots.prompt: A long-lens view down a village road to a tall wooden bell tower with a tent-shaped roof beside a small wooden church. Men run away from the tower along the road. A pause. The base of the tower bursts outward in a cloud of grey dust, the tower leans, folds at the belfry and comes down slowly, and a plume of dust rolls up the road toward the camera and swallows the frame. Rooks burst up from the birches. Locked-off camera.
shots.must_show: The bell tower coming down in dust; the church itself left standing. No one near it when it falls.

shots.prompt: Through thinning grey dust: a small wooden church still standing, a raw broken stump of timber where its bell tower was. An elderly priest kneels in the road with a hand over his mouth, coughing. Beside a parked lorry a young officer in a peaked cap writes on a clipboard, looks up at the priest, and for a moment looks ashamed. Still camera.
shots.must_show: The aftermath: the stump, the priest on his knees, Volkov's moment of shame.

shots.prompt: Handheld, following two kerosene lanterns down a narrow stone stair into an old vaulted undercroft, the whitewash gone to bare stone. At the bottom, a low heavy wooden door, and above it, hanging on a thin chain, a small votive lamp: a glass cup in a brass holder with one small steady flame. The camera stops and settles on the lamp's flame; the stone above the door stays in deep shadow.
shots.must_show: The descent and the lamp still burning over the crypt door, shot the way a church is shot. The carved line over the door stays in shadow (the subtitle carries it).

shots.prompt: The camera cranes down from a low doorway into a small vaulted stone crypt the size of a kitchen, bare walls, one stone step before a bare stone altar slab. On the step, alone, stands a small dark metal vessel the length of a forearm, a cylinder with a domed lid, a grey wax seal over a cord. Lantern light. Men in coats crowd the doorway behind and go quiet.
shots.must_show: The vessel alone on the step; nothing else in the room, no silver.

shots.prompt: An elderly Orthodox priest with a long grey beard stands in a low stone doorway between two young men in town coats, lit by a lantern from below. He is not pleading; he is asking, gently and firmly, the way a father speaks to a son. Still camera, medium shot.
shots.must_show: Serafim asking Arkady, by name, not to open it; dignity, not fear.

shots.prompt: Extreme close-up in lantern light: a young man's hands slide a knife under an old grey wax seal on a small dark metal vessel; the wax lifts in one curl; the hands undo a cord and lift a domed lid. The camera pushes in to the open mouth of the vessel: inside, a dark liquid moves when the lantern shakes and catches the light the way only something wet does. Nothing spills. Very shallow focus.
shots.must_show: The seal broken and the lid lifted; the inside dark and wet. Nothing runs or spills (the Gore-safe version; a shot_15_gore clip may add the drop).

shots.prompt: In a small stone crypt a young officer stands up too fast from a stone step and turns to the men in the doorway, speaking briskly, his face wrong. The men move past an elderly priest who stands very still in the low doorway, no longer asking anything. Lantern light, still camera.
shots.must_show: Volkov's clever answer ('paint') and Serafim's stillness: four days.

shots.prompt: A cold whitewashed mortuary room off a 1930 district hospital ward: plank trestles, a cold tiled stove, an enamel basin, a frosted window. Three still shapes lie under white sheets drawn up over their faces; a nurse in a white headscarf stands in the doorway to the ward with her back to us. The camera dollies slowly along the trestles and stops on the nearest sheet: it rises once at the chest, as if someone under it drew breath. The shot ends there.
shots.must_show: The three under their sheets awaiting the cart; the one breath under the nearest sheet. Nothing sits up, no blood.

shots.prompt: Night, a snowfield, long lens: a line of soldiers in long greatcoats and winter caps with rifles slung, forty metres apart, their backs to the camera; a field telephone on a wooden post, a fire burning in an oil drum. Far beyond them, at the end of a road, a small village burns, the black stump of a church tower against the flames; tiny figures walk slowly in the firelight far away. Wind-blown snow, locked-off camera.
shots.must_show: The cordon and the burning village far off; the walkers too far to tell who they are. No shooting, no screams.

shots.prompt: At night by lantern light: the plank double door of a small wooden church, shut, with a rough blank board nailed across it; a hammer's last blows from a hand just out of frame. Below the board, an iron key ring hangs on a nail, untouched. Firelight flickers on the wood from behind the camera.
shots.must_show: The church nailed shut; the keys left on their nail. The board is blank in the clip (the in-engine stand-in paints the quarantine words).

shots.prompt: Night, a hard-class railway compartment of 1930: varnished wooden benches, a luggage rack, an oil lamp swinging on its chain. A young man in a civilian coat, cap off, sits bolt upright with a small dull grey metal case on his knees and both arms around it, staring at nothing. Snow streams past the black window. He does not sleep. Still camera, the lamp swinging.
shots.must_show: Volkov on the Moscow train holding the case; fear, not sleep.

shots.prompt: Late spring: a dry rutted country road between birches in full leaf, tall grass and nettles on both sides, and at the end of it nothing: no church, no tower, no houses, only a few blackened timbers half hidden in the nettles. Rooks circle. The camera dollies slowly along the ruts at knee height, as in the first shot.
shots.must_show: The same road as shot 1, empty: nothing stands.

shots.prompt: Heavy rain over a front-line trench in autumn 1944: brown flooded trench floor, sandbags, duckboards, a machine-gun position under a sagging tarpaulin, telephone wire on stakes, barbed wire, shell holes full of water; far off in the rain a church spire with no roof. Steel helmets move under the parapet; no faces close. The camera tracks slowly along the trench at waist height.
shots.must_show: The German line in the rain, wretched and wet; helmets, no faces.

shots.prompt: Inside a dugout roofed with logs, rain dripping through: a trench periscope, a wooden field telephone, a map under oilcloth, a candle in a tin. Three officers in hooded rain capes stand at a narrow observation slit, rain beyond it. Still camera from the back of the dugout.
shots.must_show: The Soviet observation post: the slit, the telephone, three men in rain capes.

shots.prompt: At a dugout's observation slit two officers in rain capes look out through binoculars at the rain; between them a third man, older, grey at the temples, in a peaked cap and rain cape, does not look through anything, his hands inside his cape. A field telephone buzzes on a ledge beside him. Still camera.
shots.must_show: Volkov (forty now) between the two army officers, not looking, waiting for the call.

shots.prompt: Close-up: a gloved hand holds the handset of a wooden field telephone in the grey light of an observation slit, then passes it without a word to another hand. The face of the first man is blurred behind, lit from the slit. Still camera, shallow focus.
shots.must_show: The handset passed: the order is Moscow's, given through him.

shots.prompt: A battery of field guns fires in the rain at dusk, seen from behind the crews: the guns recoil, smoke and spray, the crews in rain capes turning away from the blast. Long lens, locked-off camera.
shots.must_show: The salvo going out. Nobody is shown being hit.

shots.prompt: A long lens on a distant muddy trench line in heavy rain: shells land with dull thuds and do not explode; each one splits open in the mud and lets out a low, dirty puff of smoke that lies down on the ground in the rain instead of rising. Far off, small figures in the trench stand up and look at them. Nobody is hurt.
shots.must_show: The wrong, soft bursts: no fireball, no splinters; the puffs lying down in the rain.

shots.prompt: At a dugout's observation slit an army officer in a rain cape lowers his binoculars slowly and turns his head to the man beside him, asking without words. Grey light from the slit, rain beyond. Still camera, two-shot.
shots.must_show: The colonel's silent question.

shots.prompt: Close on a man of forty in a peaked cap and rain cape at an observation slit, grey at the temples, his face lit grey by the light from the slit. He answers without taking his eyes off the far trench, his face completely still. Rain on the logs above. Still camera.
shots.must_show: Volkov answering (they only need to open), eyes on the trench.

shots.prompt: A grey morning after rain under low cloud: canvas aid-station tents, a towed field kitchen with a boiler and a steaming kettle, young soldiers in greatcoats and fur caps standing with mess tins, their backs to the camera. Crows. Still camera.
shots.must_show: The rear four days later, ordinary and tired.

shots.prompt: The camera cranes slowly up over a row of eight fresh earth mounds behind field tents, each with a small plain wooden pyramid marker, a shovel still standing in the spoil heap, low cloud above. Quiet and respectful.
shots.must_show: The field graves, shown with respect.

shots.prompt: Low and close on one fresh earth mound with a small wooden pyramid marker: a clod of earth rolls down its side; the soil along the mound's spine begins to rise slowly, as if something beneath is lifting it, and the wooden marker leans. Out of focus behind, soldiers at a field kitchen turn, one by one, to look. Still camera.
shots.must_show: The earth moving on the grave; the soldiers turning. Nothing breaks the surface in the clip.

shots.prompt: The faces of young soldiers in greatcoats and fur caps, boys, turning to look at something off screen. One slowly takes off his cap. One crosses himself and glances round to see who saw. An older sergeant's hand goes to his rifle sling and stops there. Still camera, medium close.
shots.must_show: Their faces: awe and fear, not panic; the cap off, the sign of the cross, the hand that stops.

shots.prompt: A wooden field radio set on a two-wheeled cart beside a field kitchen, its tall whip aerial against low grey cloud; a young soldier in headphones sits frozen at the set, listening, his pencil not moving. A kettle boils over behind him. Still camera.
shots.must_show: The radio cart: the report going up and the order to keep silent coming back.

shots.prompt: A very long lens, parallel to a muddy road on a grey morning: a long loose line of figures in greatcoats stiff and white with frost walks slowly west along the road and beside it, some bareheaded, some wrapped in cloth, some barefoot, walking the way very tired men walk. Dozens of them, flattened by the lens into one slow procession. The camera tracks slowly beside them.
shots.must_show: The risen walking west, dozens, slow and quiet; not monsters, men.

shots.prompt: Beside a muddy road a battery of field guns stands silent, the crews standing back from them as a slow line of frost-white figures in greatcoats walks past between the guns. One gunner lifts a hand toward a passing figure as if to stop a friend, then lets it fall. Nobody shoots. Long lens, still camera.
shots.must_show: The crews letting them pass; the hand raised and lowered. Nobody shoots.

shots.prompt: Inside an industrial mill hall at night, 1944: a very fine pale powder slides down behind the glass front of a tall sifting machine, lit from inside the machine, so fine it hangs in the air, into a steel hopper; below it a steel canister slowly fills. Men in rubber gas masks, rubber aprons and gauntlets work at the hopper. Bare walls. The camera tracks slowly along the glass at close range.
shots.must_show: The dust: so fine it floats; the masked crew. No emblems, no flags anywhere.

shots.prompt: A woman scientist in her forties in a white laboratory coat over a dark dress, hair pinned up, a pencil in her hand, stands at a bank of three large round dial gauges and a wall clock in a mill hall, watching the needles, not the men behind her. Hard work light. Still camera, medium shot.
shots.must_show: Dr. Reinholt at the gauges, measured and tired.

shots.prompt: Close-up: the needle of a large round analogue gauge sits high and trembles; a woman's hand writes a figure in a small notebook with a pencil, then the pencil stops. The dial face is blank of any readable words or numbers. Still camera, shallow focus.
shots.must_show: The resonance needle high; the figure written down (no readable dial text).

shots.prompt: Outside at night in deep snow under floodlights: six squat rockets on a steel rail launching frame point east at a black line of hills; a crew in white winter overalls works around them; a wooden control hut with an open lit door. Snow falls through the floodlight beams. The camera tracks slowly along the frame.
shots.must_show: The rockets on their rail aimed east, the crew in whites, no markings on anything.

shots.prompt: Close-up under a floodlight in falling snow: gloved hands tighten the clamp of a plain steel canister under the nose of a rocket on a launching rail, then step back. No markings. Still camera.
shots.must_show: A canister clamped to a rocket.

shots.prompt: Night on a snowy hilltop: a small plank weather hut with one lit window, an instrument screen on legs, and a tall mast with spinning anemometer cups and a wind vane in silhouette against the sky. Wind, snow blowing. Still camera.
shots.must_show: The weather station on the hill, the vane pointing steadily east.

shots.prompt: From a hilltop at night, a wide snowy valley below dotted with the small warm lights of a village, a few farms, and a lone lamp at a crossroads far off. Calm, still, cold. Locked-off camera.
shots.must_show: The villages' lights in the valley: everyone who lives there.

shots.prompt: Seen from a snowy hilltop at night: six bright streaks of rocket exhaust rise low over the dark hills one after another and race away east, their glare lighting the snow; small figures of a crew in the foreground watch them go. Long lens, locked-off camera.
shots.must_show: The launch going east. No explosions, no targets.

shots.prompt: Close on the spinning cups of an anemometer on a mast at night: the cups slow down, stop, and begin to turn the other way. Snow streaks past. Still camera against the night sky.
shots.must_show: The wind dropping and turning.

shots.prompt: A metal wind vane on a mast at night swings slowly a quarter turn, hesitates, then swings all the way round to point the other way; the anemometer cups below it race. Snow now blows from the other side. Still camera, the vane in silhouette.
shots.must_show: The vane swinging round: the weather report going wrong.

shots.prompt: At night, along the line of a dark ridge, a low glowing haze lit from inside by nothing pours over the crest and rolls down toward a valley like a slow wave of fog. Long lens, locked-off camera from a hilltop.
shots.must_show: The dust coming back over the hills.

shots.prompt: A wide night valley seen from a hilltop: as a low rolling haze reaches them, the small lights of farms and a village go out one by one, until only a few distant floodlights are left. Locked-off camera, slow push in.
shots.must_show: The lights going out one by one. No people in frame.

shots.prompt: In a deep concrete vault at night, a woman scientist in a white coat, alone, a pencil behind her ear, turns a large heavy dial on a console all the way to its stop, her face lit from below by a strong glow; she is not looking at the gauges now, and her lips move as if counting. Still camera, close.
shots.must_show: Reinholt alone at the Heart's console, turning it to the stop; love and terror, not villainy.
